subject: Agreement origination & party roster — playlist for redlines and exhibit clarity
messages:
From: Nora Li <nora.li@fluxpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T20:45:00Z
Subject: Agreement origination — party roster & a few clarifying asks

Hi Kimberly / Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. Attaching our current MSA draft so you have context. High-level asks from our side to help the initial pass: 

- We have one primary signer (Ethan Romero, GC) and a billing contact (procurement@fluxpay.com). Please confirm the format you prefer for signatory details (name + title + email or a signed signer matrix).
- Data residency: FluxPay keeps most production in us-east-1 but we have EU customers. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support US-only residency for this agreement or if you need multi-region language?
- We expect a fairly quick timeline (we'd like a first redline back by end of next week).

Attachment: FluxPay_MSA_v1.pdf (PDF, 480KB)

Would appreciate a short checklist or template you want us to fill out with party contacts and billing addresses — saves back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Nora Li
Senior Contracts Manager
FluxPay

[Attachment: FluxPay_MSA_v1.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nora Li <nora.li@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T22:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Agreement origination — party roster & a few clarifying asks

Hi Nora — thanks for the MSA. Looping in Soojin (legal) and David (contracts ops) to coordinate the first review.

Quick plan: 
1) Please complete the attached small party sheet (attached) with the primary signatory, billing address, and any sub-entity names you want captured. That will let us populate the Order Form cleanly.
2) We will do an internal redline pass and share a PDF mark-up + a short summary of priority clauses (liability, IP, data residency) by next Wednesday EOD. If timeline slips, we'll flag earlier.
3) Can you confirm whether FluxPay requires: SOC 2 evidence (yes/no), specific DPA terms, and any additional export-control or residency constraints?

Proposed sync: 30 minutes on Thurs 7/24 at 10am PT to walk redline highlights and signatory map — does that work for you and Ethan? If not, propose a time.

Attachment: Party_Sheet_Template.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

Thanks — kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracting, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Nora Li <nora.li@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-23T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Agreement origination — party roster & a few clarifying asks

Thanks Nora — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few items Legal wants to flag on the first pass so you can consider ahead of our redline: 

- Liability cap: we typically cap liability at the greater of $5M or 12 months of fees. If FluxPay has a preferred number, please flag it now so we can evaluate.
- Data residency & access: Our standard MSA allows multiregion hosting; if FluxPay needs US-only residency we can add a residency clause scoped to Order Forms (we'll propose language). We will need to understand whether any EU customer data must remain in-region.
- IP/derivative works: Redwood asks for a license back for customer-provided prompts only to the extent necessary to provide the service. If GC prefers broader assignment/ownership language, flag examples.
- Security evidence: please share SOC 2 Type II report (or a link) and contact for security questionnaire.

We'll assemble a short "redline summary" that highlights which clauses we consider negotiable vs. non-negotiable. Expect a PDF mark-up plus a one-page priority list.

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Soojin / Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: public link here: https://security-reports.fluxpay.com/soc2-2025-report.pdf (attached copy as well).
- Signer: Ethan Romero, General Counsel (ethan.romero@fluxpay.com) — he will be the primary on the MSA, procurement@fluxpay.com will handle billing info.
- Residency: FluxPay prefers US-only residency in the contract, but we'll note any EU customer carveouts in the party sheet.
- IP: Ethan asked to keep the IP language narrow; he reviewed Redwood's template and suggested two small edits to the IP license paragraph — we can surface those after your redline.

We filled the Party_Sheet_Template and attached it; hope that helps. We're happy to sync Thurs 7/24 at 10am PT — Ethan will join.
